reviews.title: Legacy access missing after iOS 27.0
reviews.text: This is a great ad-blocking app that I have had since it released in 2015. However, one new issue is that legacy access has been missing since installing iOS 27.0. Legacy access did not return after clicking “restore purchase” in the app, reinstalling the app from the App Store, restarting the iPhone, updating to versions 6.6.3 and 6.6.4 of 1Blocker, and installing iOS 27.0.1. This might be an iOS 27 syncing issue because legacy access was working well on iOS 26.6.2 and earlier.

reviews.title: 10 Years Later, I Still Recommend OneBlocker
reviews.text:
BLUF: I’ve used OneBlocker for over 10 years, I bought the lifetime version years ago, and I absolutely recommend it.

It does what I bought it to do: reduces ads and trackers. I’ve seen it block thousands of them, and I only have a handful of apps on my iPhone.

It even helps with ads in some of my games. Sometimes instead of sitting through a 30-second or one-minute ad, I get a black screen. I just close the app, restart it, and keep going. I’ll take that any day over being forced to sit through an ad I never wanted to watch.

I already use Apple devices and Safari, so OneBlocker fits perfectly into my setup. After all these years, I’m still very happy I bought the lifetime version.

THE Tech Voyager recommends OneBlocker for anyone using Safari who wants to cut down on ads and trackers.

It works. That’s really all I need it to do.

reviews.title: Not what it looks like
reviews.text:
I checked into the settings on this app, specifically the “Allow” lists on tue various categories. Thousands of allows that effectively render whatever blocking this app might be capable of virtually useless. Whether this is by design or if people have managed to insert exceptions when the VPN is off, after invoking another VPN, for example, this is not acceptable. There needs to be, at a minimum, a fast way to disable these unwanted exceptions without having to individually go through vast lists, one item at a time.

I will not renew this and am using another blocker going forward.
